thread.title: Tigress upgrades Intel to Buy, sees 'significant' share upside

author: fifcadmin
title: Tigress upgrades Intel to Buy, sees 'significant' share upside
text:
April 5, 2018 - 1:41pm The Fly 
Tigress Financial analyst Ivan Feinseth upgraded Intel to Buy from Neutral without a price target. The stock in afternoon trading is up 35c to $50.34. Intel is benefiting from increasing demand for processors used in data centers, cloud computing, enterprise storage and Internet of Things connectivity, Feinseth tells investors in an intraday research note. He believes the company's potential loss as a chip supplier for Apple's (AAPL) Mac in 2020 will not be material as gains in its Data Center Group will more than offset it. The analyst also sees Intel's Non-Volatile Memory Solutions Group as an additional catalyst for growth. Feinseth believes "significant upside exists" from current share levels.
